review.tagline: Self-hosted inference server with OpenAI-compatible API and pluggable backends
review.summary: LocalAI serves LLMs, vision, speech, image and video models behind OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs and Ollama-compatible APIs. Each backend (llama.cpp, vLLM, whisper.cpp, diffusers, MLX and others) is a separate OCI image pulled on demand. It also ships a web UI, API-key auth with quotas, built-in agents with MCP, and a distributed mode using PostgreSQL and NATS.
review.audience: Self-hosters wanting a local, OpenAI-compatible server for many model types
strengths: Covers text, vision, speech, image and video models behind one API
Runs on CPU, CUDA 12/13, ROCm, Intel oneAPI, Vulkan, Apple Silicon and Jetson
Backends install on demand, so only the engines a model needs are pulled
Includes API-key auth, user quotas and a distributed mode for horizontal scaling
weaknesses: Distributed mode requires PostgreSQL and NATS
macOS DMG is not signed by Apple and needs a manual xattr command
Wide scope (agents, fine-tuning, UI) makes the feature surface large to evaluate
vllm.cpp backend is described as alpha development builds
needs: Models: GGUF, llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, transformers
